s1.syndrome_frame: Acute neurological presentation with headache, emesis, and dizziness, following a recent surgical procedure
salient_findings: Greenish discharge in the right external auditory canal
Ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe with gas-fluid level and gas bubbles
key_facts: Recent right tympanomastoidectomy for cholesteatoma 2 months prior
Normal strength in all four extremities
Proteus mirabilis and Enterococcus gallinarum cultured
Fungal, Nocardia, and Actinomyces cultures were negative

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute neurological presentation with headache, emesis, and dizziness, following a recent surgical procedure
salient_findings: Greenish discharge in the right external auditory canal
Ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe with gas-fluid level and gas bubbles
key_facts: Recent right tympanomastoidectomy for cholesteatoma 2 months prior
Normal strength in all four extremities
Proteus mirabilis and Enterococcus gallinarum cultured
Fungal, Nocardia, and Actinomyces cultures were negative

differentials: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
Brain abscess due to Burkholderia pseudomallei
per_call: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
Brain abscess due to Burkholderia pseudomallei

shortlist.label: Brain abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Ring-enhancing lesion with gas-fluid level and gas bubbles on CT, consistent with abscess formation

shortlist.label: Otogenic brain abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Recent right tympanomastoidectomy for cholesteatoma and presence of greenish discharge in the right external auditory canal

shortlist.label: Proteus mirabilis brain abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Proteus mirabilis cultured from the patient, which is a known cause of brain abscess

shortlist.label: Post-surgical brain abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Recent surgical procedure and presence of abscess formation, suggesting a possible post-surgical complication

shortlist.label: Polymicrobial brain abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of multiple organisms (Proteus mirabilis and Enterococcus gallinarum) and high C-reactive protein level, suggesting a polymicrobial infection

raw.rationale: The patient's recent right tympanomastoidectomy for cholesteatoma and the presence of a ring-enhancing lesion in the right temporal lobe with a gas-fluid level and gas bubbles, along with the culture of Proteus mirabilis and Enterococcus gallinarum, suggest an otogenic source of the brain abscess.

rejected.label: Brain abscess
rejected.why: Too general, does not account for the specific otogenic source

rejected.label: Proteus mirabilis brain abscess
rejected.why: Only one of the cultured organisms, does not explain the full context of the case

rejected.label: Post-surgical brain abscess
rejected.why: While the patient had recent surgery, the otogenic source is more specific and relevant to the case

rejected.label: Polymicrobial brain abscess
rejected.why: While the patient has multiple organisms cultured, the otogenic source is the most important factor in this case
